wayback._eras_note: lakestar.com carried four site generations: a WordPress site 2011-2013 (/portfolio, /portfolio/<slug>, /about-us/the-team), a parked page 2014-2017, a single-page site 2018-2021 (logo strip on the homepage and /about), a Next.js site 2022 to June 2026 (/portfolio with per-company pages at /company/<slug>, /team/<slug>, /news/<slug>) and the July 2026 relaunch read live through site_api. The archive eras are parsed by scratch/archive_listings.py into sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json with capture_url per row; no era here is a wayback-pull.py parser, so this list stays empty and the parsed files are the record.

roster._note: The team pages mix the investment team with finance, legal, talent, communications and investor relations. The sweep roster is the investing people only (partners, principals, investment directors, associates, venture partners), curated in sources/wayback/partner-roster.json from the archived /team/<slug> pages with capture-year tenure windows (decisions.md D4).

site_api._note: www.lakestar.com since the July 2026 relaunch is Next.js on a headless WordPress (wp-json open): three logo blocks (home 11, /funds 15, /resilience 21), each logo an image with an optional link to the company's site, plus the Resilience I press release naming 20 companies. No names, dates, rounds or per-company pages; names are read from the logo file names and the links. sources/site/companies-2026.json is built by scratch/site_2026.py from sources/site/raw/wp-pages-2026-10-01.json.
site_api._team_note: The live site (July 2026 relaunch) has no team page. team-cards.json is the firm's own /team page as last captured on 2026-06-09 (30 people, the firm's titles). No group field: buckets come from the title rules in site-portfolio.py, with team_bucket_overrides for the titles that mix two roles.

External: the Chicago wealth adviser and Conexant's Lakestar Semi (namesakes), and Lakestar SPAC I SE (the blank-cheque vehicle, T5; decisions.md D3).

site_office.quote: This website is operated by Lakestar Advisors GmbH, a company incorporated and domiciled in Switzerland.
site_office.basis: Lakestar files no Form ADV (decisions.md D1: IAPD returns only an unrelated Chicago adviser), so the rule's principal office does not exist. The firm's own legal notice names the operator, Lakestar Advisors GmbH, at Bahnhofstrasse 18, 8001 Zurich (read 2026-10-01), the Swiss register gives the same seat for Lakestar Advisors GmbH and Lakestar Holding AG (Zefix), and the firm's 2026 press release is datelined 'ZURICH / LONDON / MUNICH'. London (Lakestar Advisors UK LLP, 95 Gresham Street) and Berlin (Lakestar Advisors Germany GmbH) are its other offices.

socials_gap.cause: The firm's sites publish no personal links: the 2022-2026 team CMS carried none and the site relaunched in July 2026 has no team page. The session's web-search budget was spent on the portfolio, so no checked search ran for the 30 people.

profile._note: No Form ADV exists (decisions.md D1), so the ADV-anchored fields of COLLECTION.md s11 (aum, the principal office) have no sworn source: AUM is firm-stated and flagged, the office comes from the firm's legal notice. The archived rows carry no sector tags in the base, so the focus list is derived from the grind's focus column (the Thrive convention), published at 7 companies or more (about 4.5% of the base).
